question: Can the registered two-path design be admitted with the records in hand?
definition: A read-only audit of C1-C9 against the A0, provenance and carrier-trace artifacts. It runs no cell and chooses no intervention.
verdict: NOT ADMISSIBLE — 0 SATISFIED, 9 REQUIRING INSTRUMENTATION, 0 UNSATISFIABLE
reading: No condition is impossible. None is cleared. The design is blocked by missing instrumentation, not by a demonstrated impossibility.

conditions.basis: A0 supports the parallel-path premise: 26/26 rows form a carrier with zero direct service; candidate formation is upstream but not independent, and admission leaves the carrier intact. No A- or K- cross-block was executed, so the two manipulations have not been shown to leave each other's path intact.
conditions.clears_with: Implement A- and K-; show A- leaves K intact and K- leaves served availability intact on every seed within the precommitted tolerance.

conditions.basis: No A-, K- or Y- execution exists in the committed artifacts. The A0 and provenance records are observational joins, not manipulations.
conditions.clears_with: Run each manipulation and verify it drives its named path to zero while leaving the other path's measured quantity above zero.

conditions.basis: The 26-row A0 slice is selected on never-served direct edges and every row has a carrier: 26 A-K+, 0 A+K+, 0 A+K- and 0 A-K-. The full candidate set has 492 served edges, but it has not been joined to carrier availability, so no four-cell denominator exists.
conditions.clears_with: Join every eligible edge to both factors and require a non-zero denominator in all four cells and in the Y- arm at A+K+ and A-K+.

conditions.basis: No edge-level intervention was run, so there is no neighbour or spillover measurement to compare against a tolerance.
conditions.clears_with: Run an edge-level manipulation with precommitted neighbour tolerances for A, K and Y; cluster or redesign if the tolerance is exceeded.

conditions.basis: Direct and reverse temporal counts are present for all 26 rows (23-47 direct), and they are formed before the carrier. The specified U also includes strength, but no edge-level strength field exists; carrier strength is a different quantity. U has not been joined to all four cells.
conditions.clears_with: Record direct count, reverse count and edge strength before the outcome for every eligible edge, and join U to all cells without using a post-outcome rank.

conditions.basis: Carrier formation cycles are present (37-117, median 76.0), but no artifact records an assertion cycle. K and Y therefore cannot be ordered at the same cycle resolution.
conditions.clears_with: Record the assertion cycle per edge at the same resolution as formation, then test K-before-Y against Y-before-K without reverse-time imputation.

conditions.basis: No assertion blockade exists. The Y- arm is a design specification, not an implemented manipulation, so its independence from A and K has not been measured.
conditions.clears_with: Implement Y- and show it reduces assertion without changing A or K formation beyond the precommitted tolerance.

conditions.basis: No A-K- double block exists and no precommitted ceiling has been fixed. The positive control is specified but not executable.
conditions.clears_with: Fix the A-K- ceiling before the run, execute the double block, and distinguish no route from a third route.

conditions.basis: No four-cell runner exists. A0 fixes six committed seeds, one world family, 120 cycles and cap 40, but it does not pair the four cells or the Y- arm.
conditions.clears_with: Build a runner that fixes world, seed, cycles, cap, candidate universe and U across all cells; refuse any cell whose object differs.

not_evidence: A design audit on six committed Q4 seeds, one world family, one build and one cap. It establishes no mechanism and runs no intervention.
